text.name: “Sports Guardian” refers to a person or organization that financially supports or sponsors a child's participation in sports activities, helping to cover the costs associated with sports programs or equipment.

We hope that you will help us so that financial obstacles do not limit a child's access to classes at our Swim Club by becoming a sports guardian, and by that supporting children of our local community to be able to join our club.

Our sport swimming pool is meticulously crafted to meet the exacting standards of competitive training and recreational swimming. This Olympic-sized pool offers ample space for rigorous workouts, lap swimming, and professional training sessions. Adjacent to the pool, you'll find dedicated lanes marked for specific training purposes, allowing swimmers to focus on their technique, speed, and endurance without interruption. Whether you're a competitive swimmer, a triathlete in training, or someone seeking a rigorous workout routine, our sport swimming pool is the perfect destination to hone your skills, achieve your fitness milestones, and embrace the exhilarating world of aquatic athleticism.
Kari Nordmann is responsible for the content of this collection and for the money going to the designated purpose.

Vi håper du ønsker å hjelpe oss slik at økonomiske hindringer ikke begrenser et barns tilgang til Swim svømmeklubb ved å bli idrettsfadder, og ved det støtte barn i lokalsamfunnet vårt for å kunne bli med i klubben vår.

“Idrettsfadder” refererer til en person eller organisasjon som gir økonomisk støtte eller sponsing til et barns deltakelse i idrettsaktiviteter, og hjelper til med å dekke kostnadene knyttet til medlemsavgift eller utstyr.

Welcome to our сlub, where the rhythmic pulse of water and the thrill of competition converge in perfect harmony.

Designed to exacting standards set forth by international governing bodies such as FINA (Fédération Internationale de Natation), the sports pool adheres to precise dimensions that mirror those of Olympic venues. Measuring a staggering 50 meters in length and 25 meters in width, with a minimum depth of 2 meters, the pool offers a vast canvas for swimmers to unleash their full potential with every stroke and kick.
